item.title: Iran war the latest crisis affecting food banks as usage in Toronto hits record high
item.description: Toronto’s largest food bank says it’s been dealing with crisis after crisis as the war in Iran makes it even more expensive to feed the thousands of food insecure Torontonians who rely on it.

item.title: Artemis II toilet acts up again as astronauts speed toward the moon to break Apollo 13's record
item.description: HOUSTON (AP) — Now more than halfway to the moon, the Artemis II astronauts prepared for their historic lunar fly-around to push deeper into space than even the Apollo astronauts. On the downside, their toilet is on the blink again.

item.title: Taber, Alta., named Hockeyville winner over Tumbler Ridge, B.C.
item.description: TABER — A southern Alberta community that lost its only two ice rinks after a Zamboni explosion has been named the Kraft Hockeyville 2026 winner. Taber, Alta., was one of two finalists, along with Tumbler Ridge, B.C.

item.title: FETTER, Marie Edith (nee Cummins)
item.description: Nov. 30, 1931 – April 2, 2026 Marie, in her 95th year, died peacefully in her home with her friends and family at her side. She was predeceased by her parents, Mernie and Howard Cummins, and her husband, Don.

item.title: Artemis II mission highlights deep space effects on astronauts’ bodies
